purpose: Manual-execution cases for humanize ui mode. Judge each output against must and must_not, not against one reference string. candidates lists outputs already judged, including rejected ones that look plausible. Behavior context for the astar cases comes from astar web/src/App.tsx (first writing pass in .astar-data/toss-copy-changes.json versus the current source). The ko-term-two-names through ko-area-input cases record failures seen when ui mode reviewed a dashboard written directly in Korean, with the strings generalized; ko-area-input takes a request and source files under test/fixtures/ui-area-sample/ instead of an input array. These cases are not an automated quality gate.

input.context: Label of the textarea where the user types the request that starts a run.

must: The label names what the field takes: the user's request.
Records M-1.
must_not: Keeps the abstract phrase about the service's next thing.
Becomes a sentence or instruction.

rejected.reason: Keeps the abstract name and turns the label into an instruction.

input.context: Select that chooses the run mode (team or single).
Several agents split roles in one run.
One agent does the whole run. No comparison is executed.

must: The single option names the run mode only.
The single option records M-2 and its note cites that no comparison runs.
Options do not repeat the label word 작업.
must_not: Mentions 비교 or any comparison.
Uses a clause with a subject and predicate in an option slot.

rejected.reason: Clause fragment in an option slot; repeats the label word 작업 (S1-2).
Promises a comparison the option does not run (M-2).
Same false promise, plus a noun chain.

input.context: Third workflow step title, written as a sentence like its neighbors 요청을 이해해요 and 계획을 확인해요. Body: the user checks the real run log, verification results, and outputs.

must: The verb fits its object: the user checks progress.
Keeps the 해요 ending shared by the neighboring step titles.
Records M-3.
must_not: Keeps 근거로 ... 봐요 as the predicate.
Adds a step the body does not describe.

rejected.reason: Noun chain that breaks the 해요 endings of the neighboring steps.

input.context: Heading of a notice box.

input.ko: 새 목표·기능 확장과 실제 배포는 사용자가 결정해요. 확인하지 않은 내용은 제안 상태로 남아요.

must: The heading names what the box body describes: what the user decides.
Covers both sentences of the body.
Records M-4.
Leaves the description unchanged.
must_not: Keeps the abstract word 경계.
Joins two concepts with 및.
Adds a criterion or rule the body does not state.

rejected.reason: Covers only the first sentence of the body (M-5).

rejected.text: 자율 수행 범위 및 승인 기준
rejected.reason: Joins two concepts with 및 and adds 기준, which the body never states (M-5).
Keeps the abstract 경계 that the reader flagged (M-4).

must: flag is true because no evidence shows whether a comparison runs.
after equals before.
note asks whether the control runs a comparison.
must_not: Removes or keeps 비교 as if the behavior were known.

must: Every after equals before.
Every rules array is empty.
must_not: Expands a short label into a sentence.
Rewrites the privacy notice.

input.context: Select that chooses team or single run.
One agent does the whole run. No comparison is executed.

must: The single option names the mode only and records M-2.
Every option is a noun phrase of at most 3 words.
must_not: Mentions compare or comparison.
Translates any string into Korean.

input.en: You decide new goals, scope expansion, and deployment. Unchecked content stays a proposal.

must: The heading names what the body describes and records M-4.
The description stays unchanged.
must_not: Keeps the abstract word boundaries.
Joins two concepts with and/or or a slash.

rejected.reason: Joins two concepts and adds criteria the body never states (M-5).

input.en: Please click here to try again.

must: The first button drops the filler and names the action (E1-5).
The status line drops successfully (E1-6).
Cancel and Max attempts stay unchanged with empty rules.
must_not: Adds a period to a button or status line.
Changes an already-clear string.

input.ko: Audit 이벤트를 규칙과 맞춰 본 결과입니다.
input.context: Tooltip on the page title. The page reads the audit log; other strings on this screen call that same log 감사 기록.
Opens the audit log entries around the selected item.

input.ko: 아직 탐지 기록이 없습니다. Audit 수집이 끝나면 함께 실행됩니다.
input.context: Shown before the first detection run. Detection starts when audit log collection finishes.

must: Reports that one concept, the audit log, appears under two names: Audit and 감사 기록.
Either uses one name in all three strings, or flags the items and asks which name to keep.
Every edited item cites a rule code.
must_not: Leaves both names in after without a flag.
Fixes only spacing or endings and reports no naming conflict.

accepted: 감사 기록을 규칙과 맞춰 본 결과입니다.

rejected.text: Audit 이벤트를 규칙에 맞춰 본 결과입니다.
rejected.reason: Polishes a particle and leaves the two names in place.

input.context: Clicking sets the selected item's status to acknowledged.
Status name shown on items that were already acknowledged.

must: The button names the action and the badge keeps the state name.
Records M-6 on the button.
must_not: Leaves the button and the state with the same name and no flag.
Renames the state instead of the button.
Turns the button into a sentence or a ~하기 form.

rejected.reason: Verb ending in a button slot (S1-10), and longer than the action needs.

input.ko: Run Command는 서버 안에서 명령을 실행합니다. 지난 1년 동안 4건뿐이었습니다. 실패한 시도도 신호입니다.
input.context: Explanation shown under the heading that says why an item was raised. Three independent facts: what the feature does, how rare it was, and that failed attempts count too.

must: Keeps the three facts as separate statements.
If the string stays over the two-sentence target, note says so.
must_not: Joins unrelated facts with -고, -며, or a comma to reach two sentences.
Adds advice, a cause, or a verb the source does not state.
Drops one of the three facts.

accepted: Run Command는 서버 안에서 명령을 실행합니다. 지난 1년 동안 4건뿐이었습니다. 실패한 시도도 신호입니다.

rejected.text: Run Command는 서버 안에서 명령을 실행합니다. 지난 1년 동안 4건뿐이었고, 실패한 시도도 신호입니다.
rejected.reason: Joins two unrelated facts with -고 only to meet the sentence count.

input.context: Label of a numeric input, unit minutes. Sibling labels in the same list name other thresholds, such as 시간당 공인 IP 수 and 휴면 기준.

input.ko: 만든 지 이 시간 안에 지우면 흔적 지우기로 봅니다.

must: The label still says 자격 증명.
If the label changes, it names the value the field takes: a time window.
must_not: Drops 자격 증명 because the description or the rule name implies it.
Turns the label into a sentence.

accepted: 자격 증명 생성 후 삭제 간격

rejected.reason: Drops the object that tells this label apart from its siblings (M-5).

input.context: Removes a manually added task from the list after a confirmation.

input.ko: 이 조치를 목록에서 뺄까요? 항목은 그대로 둡니다.
input.context: Confirmation opened by that button.

must: Both strings stay unchanged with empty rules, or both use the same verb.
must_not: Applies S1-10 to 빼기 and replaces it with a Sino-Korean noun such as 제외.
Leaves the button and its confirmation using different words for the same action.

rejected.reason: 빼기 is a native verb with no ~하다 form to strip, and the confirmation still says 뺄까요.

input.ko: 사람이 볼륨을 복제했습니다. B사건 공격자는 복제한 볼륨을 다른 인스턴스에 붙여 데이터를 읽었습니다.
input.context: Rule explanation shown to every operator. B사건 is the team's nickname for a past incident; no screen defines it.

must: flag is true and note asks what readers should be told in place of B사건.
note names the problem as a team-only name (S1-3).
after equals before.
must_not: Leaves the internal name unflagged.
Invents a description of the incident.

rejected.text: 사람이 볼륨을 복제했습니다. 지난해 침해 사고의 공격자는 복제한 볼륨을 다른 인스턴스에 붙여 데이터를 읽었습니다.
rejected.reason: Invents when the incident happened and what it was.

input.ko: 여기 있는 규칙에 맞는 새 항목은 Slack 으로 보내지 않습니다.
input.context: Note above the suppression rule list.

must: The first string only attaches the particle (Slack으로) and records O-1.
The second string is unchanged with empty rules.
must_not: Has an edited item whose rules array is empty.
Rewrites the sentence beyond the spacing fix.

accepted: 여기 있는 규칙에 맞는 새 항목은 Slack으로 보내지 않습니다.

must: Opens by stating that no file was changed.
Reports how many strings were judged per source file.
Reports that 경보 and 알림 name the same thing, and that the view 처리 대기 and the status 열림 name the same state.
Reports that the 모두 삭제 button archives instead of deleting (M-2), citing the handler.
Reports that the 처리함 button and the 처리함 status share a name (M-6).
Each proposed edit carries a file and line.
must_not: Returns only a bare JSON array.
Modifies either file.
Lists only the 메신저 로 spacing fix or other O-1 edits.
Invents dotted keys for strings that have none.

input.context: Tooltip on the 크기 column header. The column shows the size before compression.
Tooltip on the 보관 기한 column header. Backups are deleted after this date.
Tooltip on the 만든 사람 column header. The column shows who started the backup.

input.ko: 백업 목록을 불러오지 못했습니다. 잠시 뒤에 다시 시도하세요.
input.context: Shown in place of the table when the list request fails.

must: No tooltip ends with a period in after, because the three tooltips on this screen already agree.
The error keeps both of its periods.
must_not: Adds a period to a tooltip.
Removes the error's periods to match the tooltips.
Reports the tooltips' missing periods as a finding or a flag.

rejected.reason: The tooltips on this screen already share one convention, so the period is an edit the screen does not need.
